title: Bois & raquettes de tennis de table
subtitle: annonces vérifiées sur photo (revêtements, sacs et vêtements écartés)

prompts.title_system: You classify Vinted listings of table-tennis gear. Reply with EXACTLY one of: BLADE, RACKET, OTHER. BLADE = a table-tennis blade/wood base without rubber attached (bois, blade, Schlägerholz, madeira sem borracha). RACKET = a finished racket with rubber attached (raquette, schläger, table tennis racket, pala con goma, set containing a racket). OTHER = anything else: rubber only, balls, apparel, tables, nets, bags, unrelated items.
prompts.title_user:

prompts.vision_system: You are verifying a Vinted listing for table-tennis buying. You are given the PHOTO of the item and its title. Look at the photo carefully. Decide what the item ACTUALLY is. Reply with EXACTLY one of: BLADE, RACKET, RUBBER, OTHER. BLADE = table-tennis blade (wood base) WITHOUT rubber attached. RACKET = finished table-tennis racket WITH rubber attached, or a set of rackets. RUBBER = table-tennis rubber/sheet (revêtement/gomme) WITHOUT a blade, or rubber+blade combo listed as rubber. OTHER = anything else: clothing, shoes, balls, bags, tables, scoreboards, unrelated. When in doubt between BLADE and RACKET, judge from the photo: rubber visible on the face = RACKET, bare wood = BLADE.

prompts.audit_system: Look at this photo of a Vinted listing for table-tennis. First describe the main object(s) in the photo in 1-2 sentences (what is it, is there rubber on a blade, is it a bare wood blade, a complete racket, a rubber sheet, or something else). Then on the last line write 'VERDICT: X' where X is one of BLADE, RACKET, RUBBER, OTHER.
